description: DBT Varese - Viabilita', mobilita' e trasporti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.comune.varese.it. Topographic database created in accordance with the specific Lombardy Region ver. 4.0 of 1 March 2009. Road, mobility and transport. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DBT Varese — Viabilities, mobility and transport" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
